description: This file contains helper functions for a documentation chatbot, including utilities for formatting, filtering, deduplicating retrieval results, and managing document chunks and citations.

classes.name: Citation
classes.description: Represents a citation with metadata about document source, section, preview text, and score.

classes.name: DocumentContext
classes.description: Contains information about a document, including key, full text, relative path, matching chunks, relevance score, and matched sections.

classes.name: RetrievalResult
classes.description: Represents a result from vector retrieval, including source, text, score, and metadata.

methods.name: str alpha_key(index: int)
methods.description: Converts an integer index to an alphabetic key similar to Excel columns, e.g., 0->A, 1->B, ..., 26->AA.

methods.name: List[Dict] filter_hits( hits: Sequence[Dict], *, namespace: str, min_score: float, )
methods.description: Filters search hits based on namespace and minimum score.

methods.name: List[RetrievalResult] deduplicate_results(results: List[RetrievalResult])
methods.description: Removes duplicate retrieval results based on source, keeping only the highest scored result per source.

methods.name: List[Citation] build_citations(results: Sequence[RetrievalResult])
methods.description: Creates citation objects from retrieval results, assigning alphabetic keys and extracting relevant metadata.

methods.name: str format_context_for_synthesis(results: Sequence[RetrievalResult])
methods.description: Formats retrieval results into a string suitable for input to an AI synthesizer.

methods.name: float calculate_document_score(chunks: Iterable[RetrievalResult])
methods.description: Calculates a weighted relevance score for a set of retrieval chunks.

methods.name: List[DocumentContext] aggregate_chunks_to_documents( global_memory, chunks: List[RetrievalResult], top_n: int = 5, )
methods.description: Groups retrieval chunks by document, fetches the full documents, and ranks them by relevance.

methods.name: str format_documents_for_synthesis(documents: Sequence[DocumentContext])
methods.description: Formats documents with minimal metadata for AI comprehension.

methods.name: List[Citation] build_citations_from_documents( documents: Sequence[DocumentContext], )
methods.description: Converts document contexts into citation objects.

ctags.name: filter_hits
ctags.signature: ( hits: Sequence[Dict], *, namespace: str, min_score: float, )
